content: संरोधः .²1 Complete obstruction or impediment, hindrance, prevention, check; पयःसंरोधकूलंकषः <ls>Māl. 5. 19</ls>. .²2 Blockade, siege. .²3 Bond, fetter. .²4 Imprisonment; क्षुत्क्षामाः शुष्कवदनाः संरोधपरिकशिंताः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 73. 2</ls>. .²5 Decrease, lessening; संरोधादायुषस्त्वेते व्यस्यन्ते द्वापरे युगे <ls>Mb. 12. 238. 14</ls>. .²6 Suppression, destruction. .²7 Throwing, sending forth.
